text.title: Retro Facilitation Multistyle Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the per-retro `RetroInstance`: the format chosen against the team's distribution and fatigue with the previous two formats on record, a rationale that names them, the Prime Directive and anonymous 1-5 safety check with the switch to anonymous input below 3, the status walk of the previous retro's actions, 1-3 new actions each with a named person, a tracker link and a due date before the next retro, the anonymous-async collection window and clustering, and the published timebox with lean-coffee dot-votes and extension cap. Validator: `scripts/validate-retro-facilitation-multistyle.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the validator's cross-field block checks beyond the schema: `selection_rationale` mentions the `distribution`, the `fatigue_signal` and every entry of `previous_formats` (r-rationale-names-distribution-fatigue-and-history); `fatigued` means `format` is in neither previous format, `rotating` means it differs from the last one, and a third identical format in a row is allowed only with `fresh` and `participation` at or above `previous_participation` (r-fatigued-team-rotates-format); `outcome_review.last_run_at` equals `retro_date`, because the status walk of the previous actions is what sets it (r-previous-actions-reviewed-before-new-ones); every `action_items[].due_date` is on or before `next_retro_date` (r-action-items-one-to-three-owned-dated-linked); for `anonymous-async`, `window_end` is after `window_start` and every timezone in `team_state.timezones` has at least one working day in `working_days_in_window_per_timezone` (r-anonymous-async-window-and-clustering); `timebox.minutes` is at most 180 for a 30-day iteration and proportionally less down to the 90-minute top of the two-week working range (6 x `iteration_length_days`, floored at 90, capped at 180) and `overran` equals `actual_minutes` > `minutes` (r-timebox-published-and-held).

example.code: { "retro_date": "2026-05-23", "next_retro_date": "2026-06-06", "iteration_length_days": 14, "format": "mad-sad-glad", "previous_formats": ["mad-sad-glad", "mad-sad-glad"], "selection_rationale": "We always do this one and the team likes it.", "team_state": {"distribution": "async", "fatigue_signal": "fatigued", "timezones": ["Europe/Kyiv", "Europe/Lisbon", "Europe/London"], "all_participants_on_live_call": false}, "participation": {"cards": 6, "attendance": 4}, "opening": { "prime_directive_read": false, "safety_check": {"anonymous": false, "scale": "1-5", "median": 2}, "switched_to_anonymous_input": false, "non_member_manager_in_discussion": true }, "previous_actions_review": [], "action_items": [ {"text": "Fix deploys", "owner": "team", "evidence_link": "https://acme.slack.com/archives/C01/p1", "due_date": "2026-07-15"}, {"text": "Improve communication", "owner": "everyone", "evidence_link": "https://github.com/acme/platform/issues/490", "due_date": "2026-06-30"}, {"text": "Write more tests", "owner": "Dmytro", "evidence_link": "https://github.com/acme/platform/issues/491", "due_date": "2026-06-05"}, {"text": "Update the runbook", "owner": "Ana", "evidence_link": "https://github.com/acme/platform/issues/492", "due_date": "2026-06-05"} ], "timebox": {"published_before_start": false, "minutes": 150, "actual_minutes": 150, "overran": false}, "outcome_review": {"cadence": "next-retro", "last_run_at": "2026-02-14"} }
example.note: Subject violations: a live card format on an async team (r-format-matches-distribution); a rationale that says "we always do this one" and names no state (r-rationale-names-distribution-fatigue-and-history); the same format for the third time on a fatigued team (r-fatigued-team-rotates-format); no Prime Directive, a non-anonymous safety check with a median of 2 and no switch to anonymous input, and a non-member manager in the discussion (r-prime-directive-and-safety-check); no status walk of the previous actions and a `last_run_at` from February (r-previous-actions-reviewed-before-new-ones); four actions, two owned by "team" and "everyone", a Slack link instead of a tracker issue, and due dates after the next retro (r-action-items-one-to-three-owned-dated-linked); a 150-minute timebox for a two-week sprint that was not published before the start (r-timebox-published-and-held).

antipattern.description: `team_state.distribution: async` with any `format` other than `anonymous-async`, or `lean-coffee` without every participant on one live call.
antipattern.reason: r-format-matches-distribution: a live card sort across three timezones is a retro for whoever is in the overlap hour.

antipattern.description: `selection_rationale` under 20 characters, "we always do this one", or a rationale that does not name the distribution, the fatigue signal and the previous two formats.
antipattern.reason: r-rationale-names-distribution-fatigue-and-history: the next facilitator inherits a habit instead of a decision.

antipattern.description: `fatigued` with a format used in either of the last two retros, `rotating` with the previous format, or a third identical format without `fresh` and participation at or above the previous retro.
antipattern.reason: r-fatigued-team-rotates-format: the same three columns for a year produce the same three complaints.

antipattern.description: `prime_directive_read` false, a non-anonymous safety check, a median below 3 without `switched_to_anonymous_input`, or `non_member_manager_in_discussion` true.
antipattern.reason: r-prime-directive-and-safety-check: with a manager in the room and no safety check, the loudest voice reports and the rest nod.

antipattern.description: `previous_actions_review` without a status per previous action, a carried-over action carried over again instead of dropped with a reason, or `outcome_review.last_run_at` not equal to `retro_date`.
antipattern.reason: r-previous-actions-reviewed-before-new-ones: reviewing status first turns the retro into a loop with memory.

antipattern.description: Zero or more than 3 `action_items`, an owner of "team" / "everyone" / a channel, an `evidence_link` that is not a tracker issue or PR, or a `due_date` after `next_retro_date`.
antipattern.reason: r-action-items-one-to-three-owned-dated-linked: eight items owned by the team produce zero changes.

antipattern.description: For `anonymous-async`: a tool that stores author identity, a window with fewer than one working day in any participant timezone, cards not clustered before the recap, `attribution_requests` above 0, or a recorded recap with no comment window.
antipattern.reason: r-anonymous-async-window-and-clustering: one "who put this one?" and the next board is empty.

antipattern.description: No timebox published before the start, `minutes` above the proportional cap (180 for a month, 90 for a two-week sprint), `overran` that disagrees with the actual duration, or a lean-coffee topic not dot-voted or extended more than twice.
antipattern.reason: r-timebox-published-and-held: unbounded retros are the fastest route to fatigued.
